instruction: Cinematic medium shot in a suburban yard. On the left, the man in the white shirt (R1) holds up and reads papers. On the right, the man in the striped shirt and tie (R2) stands with his hand in his pocket, smiling at him. A 'SOLD' sign stands between them under bright daylight.
elements: R1 holds up and reads papers rather than R2
R2 stands with his hand in his pocket and smiles at R1 rather than R1 doing that toward R2
R1 focuses on papers while R2 directs attention toward R1
SOLD sign between R1 and R2
